style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the first phase shows a golden sponge cake and the other wholes are golden satin and milk chocolate, so toasted-crust keys with a strawberry-pink Enter sit in one warm family; no red, no violet.

images.why: Stage 'a circle 440 across' and phase 1 'a circle cut into 20 equal parts with 11 shaded': a round whole is a round cake, cut into equal wedges by the tool's own lines.
images.prompt: A round golden sponge cake with a clear, darker golden-brown baked crust ring all around its edge and a soft, lighter golden sponge top, lit gently from above.

images.why: Stage 'a bar of cells 440 long', phase 2 'a bar of 50 equal cells with 22 shaded' and phase 4 'two equal bars shaded alike': one strip of even texture is the whole bar for any number of cells (50 cells would pass the 40 skins a screen); the chapter's one golden satin ribbon, light so the deep-blue shaded cells stand apart from the unshaded ones.
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.

images.why: Stage 'a square of small squares 440 on a side' and phase 3 'a square of 25 equal small squares': one chocolate piece is drawn for each small square (25, never over 40 on a screen).
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate: a slightly rounded-square block with a raised bevelled edge (a lighter rim at the top left, a darker rim at the bottom right), a pressed-in inner panel, and a glossy highlight from light above, in a warm milk-chocolate brown.
